messages:
alex: Heads-up: planning to roll out the `config.cache_fastpath` feature flag to reduce tail latency for short sequences. Targeting a phased launch today at 11:00 PDT.

maya: I can kick the deployment at 11:00. Plan: 5% canary -> 25% -> 100% with 10m observation windows.

jonah: +1. I'll take logs/traces and watch p95/p99 during canary. Which routes are in scope?

alex: Only `api/generate` and `api/chat` initial routes. We keep embeddings and rerankers off.

samir: I'll be on-call for the window. If errors spike, what's the rollback command?

alex: Rollback is quick: `redwood flags set config.cache_fastpath false --env prod` and then revert the canary via deploy UI. Also have the CLI rollback: `deployctl rollback --service inference-runtime --to stable`

maya: Smoke checklist before enabling canary: 
- confirm infra autoscaler healthy
- warmup KV caches on canary nodes (script below)
- confirm tracing is enabled for canary

Run warmup: ```bash
./scripts/warmup_kv.sh --targets canary
```

jonah: Will run a short synthetic load (50 qps) after enabling 5% just to exercise short-seq path. I'll post logs if anything weird.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by maya at 1779000600: rollout config.flag=config.cache_fastpath=on scope=canary(5%)

maya: Kicked it at 11:00 (deploy message above). Watching deployment events in console.

samir: Metrics watching: latency dashboard pinned. If p99 > 800ms for 3 consecutive minutes, I'll start rollback and ping here.

alex: Good threshold. Also watch error rate and rate of truncated outputs. Add an alert in console quick check: alerts -> create -> p99 > 800ms for 3m -> notify #incidents + this thread.

jonah: Noticed slight increase in memory on canary node 2, but within limits. I'll snapshot heap and keep an eye.

maya: Moving to 25% in ~20m if no issues. Will call it out here before the step.

alex: If we see any request-level regressions, swap to safe default: set `config.cache_mode=legacy` for affected routes. Command: `redwood config set api/generate config.cache_mode legacy`

samir: Acknowledged. I'll be ready to flip flags. Also keeping a note: inform customer success if we hit >1% error bump.

jonah: Synthetic tests green at 5%. No errors in first 10m, p99 stable.

maya: Rolling to 25% now. Will monitor for 15m.

deploy-bot: rollout updated by maya at 1779001500: scope=25%

samir: 25% steady. p99 +20ms, error rate unchanged. No action.

alex: OK to full rollout in 15m if steady. Final check: are autoscaler and disk IO OK?

jonah: Autoscaler shows headroom, disk IO normal.

maya: Proceeding to 100% in 15. Posting here before final step.

deploy-bot: rollout updated by maya at 1779003000: scope=100%

samir: Full rollout done. Monitoring 30m. If anything looks off I'll execute rollback command and update here.

alex: Thanks everyone. Post-mortem note: keep the warmup script in deploy checklist and add a short playbook entry for `config.cache_fastpath` toggles.

maya: I'll create a short PR to add the playbook and the commands used here. :memo:

jonah: Thx — I'll add the tracing snippet to the playbook too.

samir: All clear so far. Closing observation at 1779000360 if no regressions.

alex: Closing thread — follow-up PR numbers please. :thumbsup:
